split: 50-query dev / 150-query heldout (same qid%4 split as prior benchmark)
production_change: Adaptive Soft Coverage-Constrained TopK + explicit Evidence Coverage output
production_selector: 0 facets=no-op; 1 facet preserves TopK if already covered, otherwise reserves at most one HIGH/MEDIUM direct-support candidate; 2-3 facets greedy reliable set-cover then fill by rerank order; final relative rerank order preserved; LOW/NONE or indirect candidates are never promoted for coverage
offline_dense: Chinese char 2-4 gram TF-IDF -> SVD128 -> cosine proxy; NOT BGE-M3
offline_reranker: LightGBM LambdaRank proxy; NOT production LLM reranker
offline_facet_match: char-bigram overlap candidate->facet proxy; threshold selected only on dev50 from [0.06,0.08,0.10,0.12,0.15], selected=0.12; heldout not used for tuning
important_caveat: Use results as architecture ablation, not as BGE-M3/Qwen production-model scores.
